18 State AGs Push Back on CLARITY Act Ahead of Key Senate Vote

New York Attorney General Letitia James led a bipartisan coalition of 17 other state attorneys general urging Congress to oppose the current version of the CLARITY Act ahead of Tuesday’s key procedural vote. The coalition argues that the bill could weaken state-level authority to pursue crypto fraud and investor-protection cases, while expanding the SEC’s ability to preempt state registration regimes. The group is calling on Congress to preserve states’ existing enforcement and registration powers over digital assets. — link

Canaan Sells 3,952 ETH and 54 BTC for $13.9M, Uses $5.4M for Share Buyback

Canaan said it sold all 3,952 ETH and 54 BTC held for sale at the end of August, at average prices of about $2,400 per ETH and $79,000 per BTC, generating approximately $13.9 million in cash. Of the proceeds, about $5.4 million was used to repurchase 13.6 million ADSs. The company still held 1,868 BTC at the end of August and said it plans to maintain a strategic digital asset reserve. — link

UAE Moves Digital Identity Vault Serving 12.5M Users to Avalanche

The UAE’s Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority is upgrading the blockchain infrastructure behind the UAEPASS Digital Vault to an Avalanche L1. UAEPASS serves about 12.5 million citizens, residents and visitors, provides access to more than 15,000 services, and is used by over 350 government and private-sector entities. The Digital Vault handles verified documents and credentials, with the Avalanche migration aimed at improving scalability and performance as usage grows. — link

BitMine Buys 27,180 ETH, Bringing Holdings to 5.96M ETH

BitMine said it acquired 27,180 ETH over the past week, bringing its total holdings to 5.96 million ETH as of September 13. The position represents about 4.9% of Ethereum’s 122 million ETH supply, putting the company 98% of the way toward its goal of owning 5% of all ETH. BitMine has staked about 5.07 million ETH, or roughly 85% of its holdings, and said its total crypto, cash, marketable securities and other investments were valued at $15.8 billion. — link

Strategy Skips Bitcoin Buying and Uses $139M to Repurchase STRC

Strategy said it neither bought nor sold Bitcoin and made no ATM share sales between September 8 and 13. Instead, the company spent $139.3 million in cash to repurchase about 1.42 million shares of its STRC preferred stock. As of September 13, Strategy held 845,050 BTC acquired for $63.73 billion at an average price of $75,412 per BTC. Its USD Reserve and USD Cash stood at $5.10 billion and $1.30 billion, respectively. — link

Kaiko Expands Latest Funding Round to $110M Led by S&P Global as 24/7 Markets Move Closer

Accroding to Bloomberg, S&P Global led an investment in crypto market-data provider Kaiko that expanded the company’s latest funding round to $110 million, as demand grows for infrastructure supporting round-the-clock trading on blockchain rails. DRW, Susquehanna, Royal Bank of Canada, Nasdaq, BNP Paribas, Broadridge, Coinbase Ventures, Stellar and others also participated. Kaiko previously raised $53 million in a Series B round led by Eight Roads in 2022. — link

Brazil’s Strict Capital Rules Could Push Most Crypto Firms Out of the Market

Brazil’s central bank now requires VASPs to meet stricter capital and compliance requirements, with some firms facing capital requirements of up to BRL 37.2 million (about $7.2 million). Of roughly 300 VASPs in Brazil, only 20–25 are estimated to qualify for licensing, with around 10 expected to ultimately be approved.

VASPs must apply by Oct. 30. Those that do not apply will have 30 days to wind down operations. Bitnuvem, NovaDAX, Digitra and Coinext have announced plans to end or restructure their retail businesse

EU Cyber Resilience Act Takes Effect, Crypto Wallet Vulnerabilities Must Be Reported Within 24 Hours

The EU’s Cyber Resilience Act now requires in-scope commercial hardware wallet and wallet software manufacturers to report actively exploited vulnerabilities or serious security incidents to cyber authorities within 24 hours, according to CryptoSlate.

A full notification is due within 72 hours. Final vulnerability reports must be submitted within 14 days after corrective or mitigating measures become available, while final reports for serious incidents are due one month after the 72-hour noti

UK FCA Considers Regulatory Exemptions for Tokenized Gold

The UK’s FCA is considering a bespoke regulatory regime for tokenized gold, including potential exemptions from collective investment scheme and alternative investment fund rules, the Financial Times reports.

The FCA is working with the Treasury and the Bank of England on the proposal. No decisions have been made. The Bank of England is also considering whether tokenized assets, including stablecoins, could qualify as collateral under its Sterling Monetary Framework. — link

UK-listed Satsuma Sells Entire 669.4867 BTC Treasury, Plans to Return £30.7 Million to Eligible Shareholders

UK-listed Satsuma Technology has sold its entire 669.4867 BTC treasury for £31.9 million and plans to return £30.7 million to eligible shareholders.

The UK High Court approved the capital reduction on Sept. 8, setting the return at £0.002734 per B share. Payments are expected to be made by Sept. 28 via check, bank transfer or CREST credit.

Satsuma had also expected to cancel its London listing on Sept. 14, though completion has not been confirmed. — link
